mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_task ( task_no, user_id, status, original_file_path, ocr_raw_text, final_decision, need_human_review, report_path ) VALUES ( #{taskNo}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{originalFilePath}, #{ocrRawText}, #{finalDecision}, #{needHumanReview}, #{reportPath} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, user_id, status, original_file_path, ocr_raw_text, final_decision, need_human_review, report_path, created_at, updated_at FROM audit_task WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_task SET status = #{status}, ocr_raw_text = #{ocrRawText}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE audit_task SET status = #{status}, final_decision = #{finalDecision}, need_human_review = #{needHumanReview}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE audit_task SET report_path = #{reportPath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
